paragraphs: Rabbi Ashyan in Yonah’s name, end of Terumot, chapter 1. Bon bar Kahana objects, Jerusalem Horayot, chapter 2. Ba, Chiyya in Yochanan’s name, there, Shevi'it, chapter 1. Ashyan bar Nidbakh, Rav Yeiva’s son-in-law (see there), in Rav’s name (I did not find it). Ze'ira in his name, Jerusalem Megillah 1:9 [Heilprin cites 1:11]. In Rav Yehudah’s name, Menachot 29a.
